39.gramatica: a lot of / some / a little

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How much bread?
[Kids]
A piece of bread! Just a piece!

[Leader]
How much milk?
[Kids]
A glass of milk! A big glass!

[Leader]
How much soup?
[Kids]
A bowl of soup! A hot bowl!

[Leader]
And how many chips?
[Kids]
A LOT OF CHIPS! A lot!

[All]
Some and a little and a lot —
chicken, chips and now I'm full!

cancion.titulo: A Bowl, a Glass, a Piece
cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
A bowl of soup for Valentina,
a glass of milk for me.
A piece of bread, a little butter,
and some chicken, hopefully.

[Chorus]
A lot of, some, a little —
say how much and say it right!
A bowl, a glass, a piece of something,
till you're full at night!

[Verse 2]
Erik wants a lot of chips
and Sofía wants a few.
Mateo eats a little of everything
and then he eats yours too.

[Chorus]
A lot of, some, a little —
say how much and say it right!
A bowl, a glass, a piece of something,
till you're full at night!

[Bridge]
You can count the chips, not the bread:
'how many' and 'how much' — use your head.

[Chorus]
A lot of, some, a little —
say how much and say it right!
A bowl, a glass, a piece of something,
till you're full at night!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
A parrot — what can it do?
[Kids]
It can talk! And it can fly!

[Leader]
A rabbit — what can it do?
[Kids]
It can hop! Hop, hop, hop!

[Leader]
A penguin — can it fly?
[Kids]
No, it can't! But it can swim!

[Leader]
And a dolphin?
[Kids]
Clever! Very, very clever!

[All]
Wing and tail and kangaroo —
what can your favourite do?

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
My favourite animal is a dolphin,
it can swim and it is clever.
A kangaroo can hop for miles,
a parrot talks forever.

[Chorus]
It can, it can't — tell me which,
and tell me what it's like!
Wing and tail and clever eyes —
my favourite, and yours alike!

[Verse 2]
A penguin cannot fly at all
but underwater it's the best.
A rabbit can't climb up a tree
and doesn't seem too stressed.

[Chorus]
It can, it can't — tell me which,
and tell me what it's like!
Wing and tail and clever eyes —
my favourite, and yours alike!

[Bridge]
What can't it do? That's fine as well —
nobody does everything.

[Chorus]
It can, it can't — tell me which,
and tell me what it's like!
Wing and tail and clever eyes —
my favourite, and yours alike!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
The tiger — dangerous or safe?
[Kids]
Dangerous! Very dangerous!

[Leader]
The monkey — where does it go?
[Kids]
It climbs! It climbs the tree!

[Leader]
The snake — where does it go?
[Kids]
It hides! It hides in the leaves!

[Leader]
And the elephant?
[Kids]
Slow! Slow and enormous!

[All]
Crocodile and toucan too —
wild and green, the jungle's true!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The monkey climbs, the snake hides,
the crocodile just waits.
The tiger walks through wet green light
and everybody waits.

[Chorus]
Wild and green and dangerous,
loud and slow and quick!
Every animal has a way
and every way's a trick!

[Verse 2]
The cheetah's fast, the gorilla's strong,
the anaconda's long.
The toucan's loud, the polar bear's far
and the platypus is just plain wrong.

[Chorus]
Wild and green and dangerous,
loud and slow and quick!
Every animal has a way
and every way's a trick!

[Bridge]
The elephant remembers
every path it ever took.

[Chorus]
Wild and green and dangerous,
loud and slow and quick!
Every animal has a way
and every way's a trick!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What swims in the deep?
[Kids]
A shark! A shark swims deep!

[Leader]
What has eight arms?
[Kids]
An octopus! Eight arms!

[Leader]
What has five points?
[Kids]
A starfish! A starfish on a rock!

[Leader]
And what stings?
[Kids]
A jellyfish! Don't touch it!

[All]
Wave and shell and crab and sea —
deep down there, come and see!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The crab walks sideways on the shell,
the starfish doesn't move at all.
The octopus has eight long arms
and hides behind a wall.

[Chorus]
Deep down there, deep down there,
where the water turns to blue!
Shark and jellyfish and starfish —
and they all swim past you!

[Verse 2]
The wave comes in and takes the shell,
the wave goes out again.
The sea is old and very deep
and doesn't need a pen.

[Chorus]
Deep down there, deep down there,
where the water turns to blue!
Shark and jellyfish and starfish —
and they all swim past you!

[Bridge]
A shark swims. It swims every day.
That's the present simple way.

[Chorus]
Deep down there, deep down there,
where the water turns to blue!
Shark and jellyfish and starfish —
and they all swim past you!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Ten steps!
[Kids]
Ten steps straight ahead!

[Leader]
Now?
[Kids]
Turn left! Turn left!

[Leader]
Now?
[Kids]
Turn right! Cross the bridge!

[Leader]
And what's there?
[Kids]
The treasure! We found the treasure!

[All]
Map and start and steps and finish —
left and right and don't you vanish!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Start beside the wooden gate,
go straight ahead for twenty steps.
Turn left beside the broken bench
and check the map for what comes next.

[Chorus]
Left, right, straight ahead,
cross the bridge and count the steps!
Start to finish, X marks treasure —
follow the map and don't forget!

[Verse 2]
Sofía holds the map, of course,
Mateo holds it upside down.
Erik says the treasure's here
and digs a hole in town.

[Chorus]
Left, right, straight ahead,
cross the bridge and count the steps!
Start to finish, X marks treasure —
follow the map and don't forget!

[Bridge]
Your left is not my left, you know —
so point it out before we go.

[Chorus]
Left, right, straight ahead,
cross the bridge and count the steps!
Start to finish, X marks treasure —
follow the map and don't forget!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How do you start?
[Kids]
Dear friend! Dear friend!

[Leader]
What do you tell?
[Kids]
The news! All the news!

[Leader]
How do you finish?
[Kids]
Love from me! Love from me!

[Leader]
And then?
[Kids]
The envelope! And post it!

[All]
Write and send and wait and smile —
a reply is worth the while!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Dear friend, I hope you're well,
I have some news to write.
The days are getting longer here
and Luna barks all night.

[Chorus]
Dear friend at the start,
'love from me' at the end!
Write it, fold it, post it —
and wait for the reply, my friend!

[Verse 2]
I put it in an envelope,
I send it Tuesday morning.
A letter takes a week to fly
and lands without a warning.

[Chorus]
Dear friend at the start,
'love from me' at the end!
Write it, fold it, post it —
and wait for the reply, my friend!

[Bridge — soft]
A message goes in half a second.
A letter keeps for thirty years.

[Chorus]
Dear friend at the start,
'love from me' at the end!
Write it, fold it, post it —
and wait for the reply, my friend!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How old are you today?
[Kids]
Ten! I am ten today!

[Leader]
How many candles?
[Kids]
Ten candles! Count them!

[Leader]
What's in the paper?
[Kids]
A present! A big present!

[Leader]
And what do we do now?
[Kids]
Make a wish! Then eat the cake!

[All]
Balloon and guest and game and party —
one whole year, let's celebrate it!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
There are ten candles on the cake
and a balloon on every chair.
The guests arrive at half past four
and the presents are all there.

[Chorus]
How old are you? Say the number!
Make a wish and blow them out!
Cake and games and balloons and guests —
that's what a birthday's all about!

[Verse 2]
Valentina brings a story,
Erik brings a thing he made.
Sofía brings a map of somewhere
that nobody has stayed.

[Chorus]
How old are you? Say the number!
Make a wish and blow them out!
Cake and games and balloons and guests —
that's what a birthday's all about!

[Bridge]
We celebrate the day you came.
One year older, still the same.

[Chorus]
How old are you? Say the number!
Make a wish and blow them out!
Cake and games and balloons and guests —
that's what a birthday's all about!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Can I have a hot chocolate?
[Kids]
Of course! Coming up!

[Leader]
Can I have some toast?
[Kids]
Of course! Anything else?

[Leader]
Can I have the pancakes?
[Kids]
Delicious! The best ones!

[Leader]
And at the end?
[Kids]
The bill, please! Thank you!

[All]
Menu, waiter, order, table —
say it kindly, say it able!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The waiter brings the menu over,
the table's by the window, warm.
Can I have a hot chocolate, please,
before we walk back through the storm?

[Chorus]
Can I have, can I have —
anything else for you?
Toast and pancakes, please and thank you,
and the bill when we are through!

[Verse 2]
Mateo orders four of everything
and eats about a third.
Delicious, says Valentina,
and doesn't say another word.

[Chorus]
Can I have, can I have —
anything else for you?
Toast and pancakes, please and thank you,
and the bill when we are through!

[Bridge]
'Can I have' is how you ask.
'Please' is what completes the task.

[Chorus]
Can I have, can I have —
anything else for you?
Toast and pancakes, please and thank you,
and the bill when we are through!

47.gramatica: past simple + when I was little

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Who is the baby in the photo?
[Kids]
It's me! It's me when I was little!

[Leader]
Do you remember it?
[Kids]
No! But my family does!

[Leader]
Who took the picture?
[Kids]
Grandma! With an old camera!

[Leader]
And what are you doing in it?
[Kids]
Smiling! Always smiling!

[All]
Album, photo, memory, page —
little then and now this age!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
When I was little I was smaller
than the dog I used to chase.
There's a photo of that morning
with the sunshine on my face.

[Chorus]
When I was little, when I was small —
the album keeps it all!
Photo, memory, family, smile,
one page for every mile!

[Verse 2]
My grandmother's old camera
took a hundred blurry shots.
I remember almost nothing
but the album remembers lots.

[Chorus]
When I was little, when I was small —
the album keeps it all!
Photo, memory, family, smile,
one page for every mile!

[Bridge — soft]
One day this year will be a photo
that somebody smaller finds.

[Chorus]
When I was little, when I was small —
the album keeps it all!
Photo, memory, family, smile,
one page for every mile!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Here's a clue!
[Kids]
Guess it! Guess the word!

[Leader]
How many letters?
[Kids]
Spell it! Spell it out!

[Leader]
What's the opposite?
[Kids]
Hot and cold! Big and small!

[Leader]
And who wins the point?
[Kids]
Our pair! Our pair!

[All]
Word and sound and clue and game —
every point is worth the same!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Give me a clue and I will guess,
give me a sound and I will spell.
The opposite of 'never' is 'always'
and I know that one quite well.

[Chorus]
Guess the word, spell the word,
find the pair and win the point!
Letter, sound and clue and opposite —
one more game before we stop!

[Verse 2]
Aiko always finds the long ones,
Bruno always shouts too soon.
Iris writes the letters backwards
and still finishes by noon.

[Chorus]
Guess the word, spell the word,
find the pair and win the point!
Letter, sound and clue and opposite —
one more game before we stop!

[Bridge]
A word you played is a word you keep.
That's why the game is not a game.

[Chorus]
Guess the word, spell the word,
find the pair and win the point!
Letter, sound and clue and opposite —
one more game before we stop!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Read the example first!
[Kids]
The example! Always first!

[Leader]
How many times do you hear it?
[Kids]
Twice! You hear it twice!

[Leader]
What do you write with?
[Kids]
A pencil! So you can change it!

[Leader]
And at the end?
[Kids]
Check! Check everything!

[All]
Calm and colour, try and smile —
one page done in one small while!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Read the example first of all,
it tells you what to do.
Take a pencil, not a pen,
so you can change it if you knew.

[Chorus]
Listen — you will hear it twice!
Stay calm and take your time!
Colour, write and check it over,
and every answer will be fine!

[Verse 2]
If a word is hard, don't stop there,
leave it and come back.
The exam is not a race —
just try, and stay on track.

[Chorus]
Listen — you will hear it twice!
Stay calm and take your time!
Colour, write and check it over,
and every answer will be fine!

[Bridge]
And smile — you know much more
than you knew last year before.

[Chorus]
Listen — you will hear it twice!
Stay calm and take your time!
Colour, write and check it over,
and every answer will be fine!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Who are we?
[Kids]
The Fjord Club! The Fjord Club!

[Leader]
What do we get?
[Kids]
A certificate! With our name!

[Leader]
How do we feel?
[Kids]
Proud! Very, very proud!

[Leader]
And what comes next?
[Kids]
The next adventure! Bring it on!

[All]
Thank you, team — remember, celebrate!
Goodbye for now, but not for late!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The certificate has got your name,
the hall is full of chairs.
A year ago you couldn't say
the half of what you share.

[Chorus]
Graduation, here we are!
Proud and loud and one big team!
Thank you, friends, remember this —
and celebrate the whole long dream!

[Verse 2]
Erik built a hundred things,
Valentina told them all.
Sofía found the road out,
Mateo lost his bag in the hall.

[Chorus]
Graduation, here we are!
Proud and loud and one big team!
Thank you, friends, remember this —
and celebrate the whole long dream!

[Bridge]
Goodbye is not the end at all:
the next adventure starts next fall.

[Chorus]
Graduation, here we are!
Proud and loud and one big team!
Thank you, friends, remember this —
and celebrate the whole long dream!
